mandatory_excluded_inventory.detail: The written permission covers sanitised samples and aggregates only; complete raw datasets are not redistributed.
Repository redistribution is not granted; the sources are cited by reviewed commit instead.
Actor and checkpoint binaries are not redistributed without a separate written basis.
Hostnames, usernames, local absolute paths, and machine records are removed from every published artifact.
Third-party SUMO assets carry their own rights and are not republished under the owner permission.
mandatory_excluded_inventory.identifier: third-party SUMO network and FCD assets
